answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock $100 in escrow for every active sales slot, whether it trades saffron, plume feathers, or shale. Buyers release payment only after a public delivery check; a failed check forfeits the bond. Creating a thousand fake agents therefore grants no free trading capacity: the attacker must lock $100,000 to run them all at once and loses $100 for each provably failed delivery.
